scheme_name: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi Indigenous Cows Ration For BPL Families
other_conditions: Applicant must be a livestock owner rearing Desi/Indigenous or crossbred cows.
Maximum subsidy provided for up to two cows per BPL family.
Applicant must provide the ear tag number for each cow.
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on a 3 kg daily balanced ration for up to two pregnant Desi/Indigenous cows during the last trimester, enhancing cow health and milk production.
